claim_boundary: Development and 30-video fresh selective AGQA evaluation; not full AGQA, not SOTA, and not a positive transfer result.
diagnosis: The public-question grammar over-predicted RELATION_RECURRENT for action-existence and composite programs.
Repeated calls to the same frozen VLM produced correlated false-positive observations; two-scan agreement was not independent evidence.
A focused wrapper-window verifier reduced coverage but did not eliminate negative transfer.
scientific_decision: Do not claim AGQA neural-symbolic skill-transfer success from this grounder. Preserve V65 as a consumed negative result. A future attempt requires a frozen target-native program-type router qualified on AGQA train/development and a new untouched evaluation unit; it must not tune on V65 outcomes.
other_domain_impact: NONE; WebShop, ALFWorld, DiscoveryWorld, and TIRBench artifacts were neither rerun nor modified.
